annotations.title: Set up from a ready-made template

description: Fills an empty or new venue with a typical setup in one call: e.g. "pilates" adds class types, a weekly timetable, packs with suggested prices and booking rules. replace_starter = true removes the empty starter class type made at sign-up. Returns what was added. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

template_id.description: Template id, e.g. pilates, yoga, hair_salon, restaurant, small_hotel, campsite.

name: setup_from_template
title: Set up from a ready-made template
